title: 就业偏鸽：市场却盯CPI，12月加息还加不加？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: First reaction, please. First take. What do you see in the jobs number? Yeah, it's clear you guys have covered it really well. It's a dovish report, little softer across the board. And the market's reacting that way.
segments.zh: 先说第一反应。就业数据怎么看？很明显你们已经分析得很到位了。这是一份偏鸽派的报告，整体略偏软。市场也在这样反应。

segments.en: You know, we'd already pretty much taken October off the table. And as you guys have discussed, you know, this is really not a jobs driven bond market and fed. It's much more on the
segments.zh: 其实我们早就基本排除了十月。正如你们讨论的，这真的不是就业驱动的债市和美联储。更多是在

segments.en: inflation side. But, you know, if it were too strong of a report, then it would have, you know, added to that, you know, pressure to continue to hike and maybe to accelerate that.
segments.zh: 通胀方面。但如果报告太强，就会增加继续加息的压力，甚至可能加速。

segments.en: And it's obviously we got the opposite today. So you push October off, you know, December is squarely in the mix. They're kind of signaling. They want to give you one of those.
segments.zh: 今天显然相反。所以十月被排除，十二月就完全在考虑范围内了。他们在释放信号，想给你一次。

segments.en: A lot of it's going to depend as you guys have highlighted on the inflation report. But also, just on the trajectory here of oil and then the downstream as Worship has talked about,
segments.zh: 很大程度上取决于你们强调的通胀报告。但也取决于油价的走势，以及沃什提到的下游，

segments.en: you know, the distillates and the crack spreads as important as the crude prices themselves.
segments.zh: 馏分油和裂解价差跟原油价格本身一样重要。

segments.en: Jeff, October 14th, what kind of CPI number might just open the door just a little bit to the end of this month? Open the door to, to a right hike, month end.
segments.zh: 杰夫，10月14日，什么样的CPI数据可能稍微打开月底加息的门？打开月底加息的门？

segments.en: To a right hike. Yeah, you know, you'd have to be, you know, a lot stronger for that to be the case. Particularly Jonathan, as we've seen, you know, some recent inflation
segments.zh: 对，月底加息。你得看到数据强得多才行。特别是乔纳森，正如我们看到的，近期一些通胀

segments.en: data that's been on the more positive side in terms of lower than expected. So I think that the other big issue here is just a calendar set up and the optics of hiking right in front of the midterms.
segments.zh: 数据偏正面，低于预期。所以我认为另一个大问题是日历安排，以及在中期选举前加息的观感。
